title: 2026 Environment Agency GHG charging governance QA controls

sources.title: Environment Agency (greenhouse gas emissions) charging scheme for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027
Environment Agency (greenhouse gas emissions) charging scheme

facts.source_fact: The charging scheme comes into force on 1 April 2026 and remains in force until revoked.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the effective date and do not apply it to an earlier charge period.

facts.source_fact: The scheme applies to England, except UK ETS Registry function charges which apply across the United Kingdom.
facts.expected_handling: Keep territorial extent separate for registry and non-registry charges.

facts.source_fact: Charges increase from 1 April 2027 and annually thereafter by no more than the relevant CPI measure described in the scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Version monetary values by charge year rather than treating 2026 values as timeless.

facts.source_fact: The person making an application is liable for the relevant application charge.
facts.expected_handling: Bind application charges to the applicant role.

facts.source_fact: Permit, emissions-monitoring-plan or registry-account holders are liable for applicable subsistence, determination or estimation charges.
facts.expected_handling: Bind recurring or determination charges to the correct regulated holder.

facts.source_fact: Application charges are due in full when the relevant application is made.
facts.expected_handling: Do not shift an application charge to a later annual billing event.

facts.source_fact: Part 2 and Part 4 subsistence charges are generally payable annually in advance on 1 April, subject to the scheme rules.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve advance-versus-arrears timing.

facts.source_fact: Part 3 and Part 3A subsistence charges are payable annually in arrears on 1 April.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat aviation or maritime annual subsistence as advance billing.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency may waive or reduce a charge where it considers the charge significantly disproportionate to actual costs and expenses for the activity.
facts.expected_handling: Treat abatement as a regulator decision, not an automatic discount.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 installation permit application charge stated in the scheme is £1,550.77.
facts.expected_handling: Version the amount to this charging scheme and application type.

facts.source_fact: The annual subsistence charge for a greenhouse-gas installation receiving free allocation is £4,972.02.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply this amount to installations without free allocation.

facts.source_fact: The annual subsistence charge for a greenhouse-gas installation not receiving free allocation is £3,475.22.
facts.expected_handling: Require the free-allocation status before selecting the amount.

facts.source_fact: The annual hospital or small emitter permit subsistence charge is £2,543.10.
facts.expected_handling: Keep HSE charging separate from main-installation charging.

facts.source_fact: A permit transfer application charge of £1,371.20 applies under the stated installation transfer provision.
facts.expected_handling: Tag the amount specifically as a transfer application charge.

facts.source_fact: A permit surrender application charge of £1,565.30 applies under the stated installation surrender provision.
facts.expected_handling: Do not confuse surrender with revocation or transfer charging.

facts.source_fact: A revocation charge of £1,048.38 is payable in relation to the stated revocation notice.
facts.expected_handling: Bind the charge to a revocation notice event.

facts.source_fact: An application for allocation from the new entrant reserve carries a charge of £1,497.83.
facts.expected_handling: Keep allocation-application charging separate from permit charging.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency determination rate specified for relevant emissions or parameter determinations is £156.74 per hour.
facts.expected_handling: Represent this as an hourly rate, not a flat fee.

facts.source_fact: The UK ETS aviation emissions-monitoring-plan application charge is £2,151.77.
facts.expected_handling: Tag the charge as aviation UK ETS rather than CORSIA or maritime.

facts.source_fact: The UK ETS maritime emissions-monitoring-plan application charge is £2,331.35.
facts.expected_handling: Tag the charge as maritime and preserve the 2026 scheme vintage.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable scheme, role and charge category before downstream use.
Attach scheme year and effective date to every monetary or governance rule.
Carry source URL, publisher and statutory-guidance provenance.
Do not convert a scheme charge into parcel-level emissions evidence.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents category errors and fabricated parcel data.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
